title: galium lucidum subsp. rigidum
intro: Galium lucidum subsp. rigidum, commonly known as Chinese Galium, is a plant species that belongs to the family Rubiaceae. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Galium lucidum subsp. rigidum include reducing fever, alleviating pain, and promoting digestion, while its bioactive constituents include iridoid glycosides and phenolic compounds, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties. However, further research is needed to confirm the effectiveness and safety of using Galium lucidum subsp. rigidum for medicinal purposes.
